name: Union Square
summary: Union Square is a community shopping center in Red Bank, New Jersey, offering convenient access to everyday retail and services along Route 35. With a 4.4-star rating and extended operating hours, it serves as a reliable neighborhood destination for Monmouth County residents.
demographics: Union Square in Red Bank attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income shoppers from Monmouth County, with a strong representation of families and young professionals aged 25-54. The trade area serves the affluent Red Bank community and surrounding towns, drawing visitors with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. The center caters to convenience-oriented shoppers seeking everyday necessities combined with specialty retail, with typical visitors making frequent trips for grocery shopping, dining, and service-based errands.
description: Union Square is a well-established community shopping center located in the heart of Red Bank, New Jersey, serving as a convenient retail destination for Monmouth County residents. Situated at 500 New Jersey Route 35, this open-air center has become an integral part of the Red Bank shopping landscape, offering a practical mix of retailers and services that cater to daily needs. The center maintains strong community ties and benefits from Red Bank's reputation as a vibrant downtown destination with excellent dining and cultural attractions nearby. With operating hours from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Union Square provides extended accessibility for shoppers throughout the day. The center has earned a solid 4.4-star rating from nearly 280 reviews, reflecting its consistent service and tenant mix that resonates with local residents seeking a reliable neighborhood shopping experience.
